review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of state/resilience/ and of the reports and the policy that define its score at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 (four cycles scoring the same 11 injections 0, 7, 8 and 9 caught) and on a deterministic exact analysis whose 63 self-checks pass. No detector was run and the held-out sets it discusses are synthetic. The record supports 7, 6 or 5 for the second cycle and a same-day report scores the baseline 5/11, so the draft concludes that only the first step is distinguishable from chance on the recorded counts and that the record cannot separate a jump in detection from a change in what was counted as caught. Human subject review, learner trial and publication remain pending; the French and Spanish translations have had no native-speaker review.
